title: Pampanga Real Estate Outlook: What to Expect in 2026
excerpt: From Clark's continued expansion to new mixed-use estates in Porac and Mabalacat, here's where Pampanga's property market is headed this year.
content: Pampanga's property market continues to benefit from Clark Freeport and Clark Global City's expansion, drawing both local and overseas buyers to the region.
Developers are increasingly focused on mixed-use estates that combine residential, retail, and office components, following the model set by Alviera and Capital Town.
Buyers looking for value are moving further out to Magalang, Mexico, and Porac, where land is still comparably affordable to San Fernando and Angeles.

title: A Simple Guide to Title Transfer After Buying Property
excerpt: Title transfer can feel overwhelming for first-time buyers. Here's a step-by-step breakdown of the process and typical costs involved.
content: Once a property is fully paid, the next step is transferring the title from the seller or developer to the buyer's name.
This typically involves securing a Deed of Absolute Sale, paying capital gains tax or creditable withholding tax, documentary stamp tax, and transfer tax, then registering with the Registry of Deeds.
Working with a licensed broker or in-house documentation team can help avoid delays caused by incomplete requirements or unpaid real property taxes.

title: In-House Financing vs. Bank Financing: Which One Fits You?
excerpt: Choosing how to pay for your property is as important as choosing the property itself. We break down the pros and cons of each option.
content: In-house financing, offered directly by the developer, usually has faster approval and more lenient requirements but comes with higher interest rates.
Bank financing typically offers lower interest rates and longer terms but requires more documentation and a longer approval process.
Pag-IBIG financing remains a popular middle ground for many Filipino buyers, offering relatively low rates for qualified members.

title: Clark Global City and the Neighborhoods Benefiting From Its Growth
excerpt: As Clark Global City takes shape, nearby areas in Angeles and Mabalacat are seeing rising interest from homebuyers and investors alike.
content: Clark Global City is positioned as Luzon's next major central business district, drawing comparisons to Bonifacio Global City in its early years.
Neighborhoods in Angeles and Mabalacat close to the Clark perimeter are seeing increased residential and commercial development activity.
Analysts expect property values in these areas to continue rising as more offices, schools, and retail centers open within Clark.
